channel.title: Marked to Market
channel.description: Essays on politics, money and power, written to be re-underwritten when the price moves. By Vikas Erraballi.

item.title: How I built a writing system that argues with me
item.dc:creator: Vikas Erraballi
item.description: A reading library, three guides and a review process that pushes back: how the pieces on this site get made, with the Florida op-ed as the worked example.

item.title: Florida, priced at zero
item.dc:creator: Vikas Erraballi
item.description: Democrats' national committees spent nothing on Florida's 2026 Senate race and lost it by under three points. That was a decision, and the ledger shows when it should have changed.
